purpose: Combine amplitude selection from the weakest viable log-FNP arc-length prior with Gaussian-like tail-geometry control from damping-rate curvature.
conditional_upper_extension_rule: Run 3e-4 and then 1e-3 only if the preceding strength fails the transform gate while its unpenalized delta chi2 remains below 1, thereby bracketing the weakest possible gate crossing without post-hoc optimization of the final band.
selection_rule: Choose the weakest rate-curvature addition that preserves the frozen fit-quality gate, passes multi-start and continuation gates, and removes finite-b transform sensitivity and negative active-region oscillations.
interpretation: Arc length primarily selects damping magnitude; damping-rate curvature suppresses super-Gaussian or wiggly geometry without fixing an endpoint amplitude.
